new_issues.title: Bug: an `async def` invoked service's completion is published on the public inbox lane, so every self-generated invoke cycle is unbounded
Bug: an EXTERNAL `send(..., priority=True)` is charged to the chain budget
Bug: `await start()` hangs unboundedly on a slow invoked child
Bug: async `start()` never sets the in-flight flag
Bug: a root `get_persisted_snapshot()` harvests a child actor's half-applied context
Bug: `_await_settled_for_snapshot` spins `time.sleep` on the event-loop thread
Bug: `machine_hash` set to `None` or removed silently disables `from_snapshot()` drift verification
Bug: a contradictory `configuration` key outranks `state_ids` on restore
Bug: `get_persisted_snapshot()` from `on_action_execute` returns a torn blob on async
Bug: `SyncInterpreter._deferred_this_step` is never cleared on the `wait=False` path
Bug: the `onUnhandled: "error"` fatal kill is invisible to the sender
Bug: config-level `strict: true` does not gate event names

not_filed_separately.rationale: Eight Low items ride along in meta-26.md rather than becoming eight issues; several are documentation or export fixes, and the R7-04 entry is a correction to a finding WE got wrong (the budget-renewal causal claim was refuted by our own follow-up evidence; only a narrower, already-documented residual survives).
design_constraints: DC-1 SyncInterpreter takes neither max_queue_size nor overflow_policy
DC-2 service_executor/service_pool_size do not remove the need for async def services
DC-3 onUnhandled:defer outranks the guard_denied disposition
DC-4 R7-01 has no configuration that also satisfies #174
DC-5 send_threadsafe(internal=True) is an honesty-based trust boundary
not_filed_separately.our_own_defects: C-04, C-07b (both Blockers on any runtime), CD-03, C-06, C-07, CV-B4-01, OUR-B11-01, OUR-B14-01/02, OUR-B15-01 are OUR catalogue JSON, not the library's, and are not filed upstream.
